Name: UltraSmooth
Author: palmhacker13
Description:
[center]
[size=5][b]UltraSmooth — Visual Polish, Performance Tweaks & Co-op Optimizer[/b][/size]
[size=3][i]A performance and quality-of-life companion for Stardew Valley 1.6+[/i][/size]
[/center]

[line]

[size=4][b]🌟 Overview[/b][/size]
[b]UltraSmooth[/b] is a lightweight client-side companion mod focused on smoother motion, display refresh rate pacing, lower cursor input latency, and improved stability for multiplayer co-op in Stardew Valley 1.6+.

Whether you play at 60 FPS, on standard 60Hz laptop displays (such as MacBook Air M1 or office laptops), on high-refresh monitors (120Hz, 144Hz, 240Hz+), or in co-op sessions with friends, UltraSmooth helps keep game simulation and animations running at their intended 1.0x speed while reducing common micro-stutters, particularly in heavily modded setups (SVE, Ridgeside Village, East Scarp).

[line]

[size=4][b]⚡ Key Features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Refresh Rate & Physics Pacing (60Hz / 120Hz / 144Hz / 240Hz+ / Uncapped):[/b] Paces game simulation (NPC pathing, monsters, tree falls, debris, projectiles, animations) to consistent 60 TPS natural speed while rendering at your display's refresh rate with reduced input latency.[/*]
[*][b]Adaptive 60Hz Variable Timestep:[/b] On 60Hz displays, [b]Enhanced60[/b] and [b]MonitorHz[/b] engage variable timestep with VSync. This helps prevent MonoGame's catch-up frame skipping and VSync drops down to 30 FPS when momentary frame dips occur on heavy modded farms.[/*]
[*][b]High-FPS Animation Timing Fixes:[/b] Addresses vanilla timer truncation issues at high framerates so Clint's geode cracking, fishing rod cast timing, and holding caught items continue running at normal 1.0x speed without slow-motion.[/*]
[*][b]Smart Ground Item & Debris Optimizer:[/b] Employs spatial partitioning ([i]PackedCellSpatialGrid[/i]) and physics sleeping for resting ground items. Nearby loose drops smoothly merge into clusters with optional overhead star-quality badges, reducing CPU overhead during large harvests or mining runs.[/*]
[*][b]Faster Transition Fades:[/b] Optionally speeds up normal screen fades during door and map transitions (configurable from 2.0x to 5.0x, or turned off), while leaving story cutscenes, festivals, and night transitions at their normal speeds.[/*]
[*][b]SmoothMenuStreamer (Lazy Tab Streaming):[/b] Instantiates heavy GameMenu tabs ([i]Skills[/i], [i]Social[/i], [i]Crafting[/i], [i]Animals[/i], [i]Collections[/i]) on-demand when clicked, reducing the initial pause when opening the menu (E / Esc).[/*]
[*][b]Co-op Network Buffer Expansion (Direct-IP / LAN / VPN):[/b] Expands Lidgren UDP socket buffers from 128 KB to 1,024 KB (1 MB) to help prevent connection drops when loading large modded farms. Improves player position updates and smoothing, completely bypassed in single-player. Includes an in-game guide popup with on-the-fly [TH / EN] toggling.[/*]
[*][b]Responsive Mouse Polling:[/b] Samples hardware mouse state just before drawing, reducing the software cursor delay for more responsive mouse movement.[/*]
[*][b]Sub-Frame Sprite Motion Interpolation:[/b] Smooths character and entity movement between simulation ticks on high-refresh monitors.[/*]
[*][b]Off-Screen Critter & Terrain Culling:[/b] Skips drawing off-screen critters, grass, and crops to save unnecessary draw calls on large maps.[/*]
[*][b]Ultrawide & High-Res House Renovation Camera:[/b] Expands camera boundaries and adds keyboard panning (WASD / Arrows) to Robin's renovation menu so ultrawide (21:9 / 32:9) and 4K screens can navigate the view properly.[/*]
[*][b]Background JIT Pre-Warming & Memory Coordination:[/b] Pre-warms runtime compilation in the background on the title screen and performs coordinated memory cleanups before saving to minimize saving pauses.[/*]
[*][b]SDV-Radiance & UI Info Suite 2 Compatibility:[/b] Normalizes shader clocks, cloud shadows, falling petals, and animal petting indicators to real-time speed.[/*]
[*][b]Performance Overlay (F7):[/b] Non-intrusive in-game FPS, frametime sparkline graph, RAM, and Monitor Hz diagnostic HUD.[/*]
[/list]
[line]

[size=4][b]⚙️ In-Game Configuration[/b][/size]
UltraSmooth supports both [b]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/b] and [b]Modern Config Menu (MCM)[/b] for in-game adjustments and live FPS mode switching.

[b]Framerate (FPS) Modes:[/b]
[list]
[*][b]60 FPS (Standard):[/b] Standard vanilla 60 FPS fixed timestep with background optimizations active.[/*]
[*][b]60 FPS (Enhanced):[/b] Adaptive 60 FPS mode. On 60Hz displays, uses variable timestep with VSync to reduce catch-up stutter and avoid 30 FPS drops when frame rates momentarily dip. On >60Hz monitors (120Hz/144Hz/240Hz), locks to 60 FPS fixed timestep for lower power consumption.[/*]
[*][b]Monitor Hz (60 / 120 / 144 / 240Hz+):[/b] Matches your display's refresh rate with VSync, using variable timestep, 60 TPS simulation pacing, and sub-frame sprite interpolation.[/*]
[*][b]Unlimited (Uncapped):[/b] Uncapped framerate mode for benchmarking while preserving 60 TPS physics and animations.[/*]
[/list][i]Note: Automatically switches to safe 60 FPS Fixed TimeStep during story cutscenes and multiplayer co-op sessions to maintain animation timing and synchronization.[/i]

[line]

[size=4][b]❓ Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)[/b][/size]

[b]Q: Does this work with multiplayer co-op? Do both Host and Client need to install it?[/b]
[b]A:[/b] Yes. UltraSmooth can be installed by either party or both:
[list]
[*]If [b]Client[/b] installs alone: Expands receive buffer to 1MB, helping prevent warp disconnects when entering large farms, and smooths movement locally.[/*]
[*]If [b]Host[/b] installs alone: Expands server socket buffer and broadcasts player movement at 60Hz.[/*]
[*]If [b]Both install:[/b] Full buffer expansion and 60Hz movement sync on both screens.[/*]
[/list][i]Note: Settings do not need to match between players; each client configures their own local broadcast and rendering preferences independently.[/i]

[b]Q: Is this a pixel upscaler or texture smoother like Clear Glasses / Monocle?[/b]
[b]A:[/b] [b]No.[/b] UltraSmooth focuses on motion fluidity, high refresh rate pacing, input responsiveness, and background performance — not texture filtering or pixel art modification. It is compatible to use alongside Clear Glasses or Monocle.

[b]Q: Does this work with large expansion mods (SVE, Ridgeside Village, East Scarp)?[/b]
[b]A:[/b] Yes. UltraSmooth is designed to help alleviate garbage collection pauses, loading delays, and multiplayer warp disconnects in heavy modpacks.

[line]

[size=4][b]📥 Installation[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url] (v4.0.0 or newer).[/*]
[*](Optional) Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/url] or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/49437]Modern Config Menu (MCM)[/url] to easily customize settings in-game.[/*]
[*]Download **UltraSmooth** and extract the `UltraSmooth` folder into your `Stardew Valley/Mods` folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI. Press [b]F7[/b] in-game to toggle the performance overlay if desired.[/*]
[/list]
